731:t_027:36.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Each time $$シュロウガ$$ revived, it created you again to soothe its loneliness.」

731:t_027:38.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「So you have finally broken... That is understandable.」

731:t_027:39.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Your life was created to suit someone else's needs... And it is an empty, false life at that.」

731:t_027:41.en:
$$万丈$$
「I don't care about that truth! But you did toy with $$アサキム$$'s fate and life for your own ends!」

731:t_027:42.en:
$$刹那$$
「You are... the very distortion of this planet!」

731:t_027:43.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Your words cannot reach me.」

731:t_028:1.en:
$$ランド$$
「Get a grip! The $$御使い$$ you want revenge on is right in front of you!」

731:t_028:2.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「It is useless. His sense of self is already dead.」

731:t_028:3.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「But his eternity will continue within me...」

731:t_029:1.en:
$$アポロ$$
「That bastard $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ swallowed it up!?」

731:t_029:2.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Now I have eight $$スフィア$$s. Preparations for the Supreme God's rebirth will soon be complete.」

731:t_029:4.en:
$$赤木$$
「What was that about a Supreme God...!?」

731:t_029:5.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Exactly what I said. My greatest goal is to complete a new Supreme God so we can survive the universe's great collapse.」

731:t_029:6.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Farewell, $c... Your power can no longer change the situation.」

731:t_029:7.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Thank you. I will remember you too as warriors who worked to save the universe.」

731:t_030:1.en:
$$シャア$$
「All units, return immediately! We'll regroup and pursue him!」

731:t_030:2.en:
$$キラ$$
「But how do we follow him...?」

731:t_030:3.en:
$$トライア$$
「I have an idea where he is going.」

731:t_030:5.en:
$$トライア$$
「If $$エス・テラン$$'s ley lines are no different from our Earth's, their stronghold can only be there.」

731:t_030:7.en:
$$ランド$$
「Let's go! I'll be damned if I let them use $$アサキム$$ any longer!」

731:t_030:8.en:
$$セツコ$$
「We'll rescue him from the $$御使い$$s... so we can settle things with him ourselves!」

731:t_030:9.en:
$$クロウ$$
「We also have to avenge $$サクリファイ$$, who finally came to understand us.」

731:t_030:10.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Let's go, $n. Let's go to the site of the final battle.」

731:t_031:0.en:
$$葵$$
「We've cleared out the enemies around him!」

731:t_031:2.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I have always been alone. I have no intention of relying on anyone's power.」

731:t_031:3.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Come, then. I hope you will soothe my loneliness.」

731:t_100:0.en:
$$勝平$$
「$$アサキム$$! I'm going to avenge Uncle $$デンゼル$$ and Big Bro $$トビー$$!」

731:t_100:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I understand how you feel, mourning someone you have lost like that.」

731:t_100:2.en:
$$勝平$$
「You're the one who killed them! You don't get to say that!」

731:t_100:3.en:
$$アサキム$$
「That is why I will end everything here. And for that, I will need your power too!」

731:t_101:0.en:
$$万丈$$
「You've put us through hell since the $$多元戦争$$. It seems the time has come to repay you.」

731:t_101:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Yes... It is time to settle this. With you as offerings, I will gain new power.」

731:t_101:2.en:
$$万丈$$
「You arrogantly believe everything belongs to you! $$ダイターン$$ and I will smash that arrogance!」

731:t_101:3.en:
$$アサキム$$
「If only that anger could burn away my false eternity!」

731:t_102:0.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「I won't show mercy to a guy who doesn't just covet other people's things, but takes them by force!」

731:t_102:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I will accept any harsh words or contempt. That is all I am worth.」

731:t_102:2.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Stop saying things that don't make sense! Either way, I'm not listening to anything you say anymore!」

731:t_102:3.en:
$$アサキム$$
「That is fine. Only one of us, you or I, will go on!」

731:t_103:0.en:
$$アサキム$$
「My existence is just like that puppet you control.」

731:t_103:2.en:
$$アサキム$$
「No... That is not right. Unlike your puppet, I will not forgive those who control me.」

731:t_103:3.en:
$$正太郎$$
「We're offering to join forces to defeat the $$御使い$$s...! If you refuse, we have no choice but to fight!」

731:t_104:0.en:
$$甲児$$
「We tried to meet you halfway and you rejected us, so don't complain when we punch you!」

731:t_104:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「As I told you, help from the likes of you would be meaningless.」

731:t_104:2.en:
$$甲児$$
「Brace yourself, $$アサキム$$! Those same people are going to beat you!!」

731:t_104:3.en:
$$アサキム$$
「If you can do that, then even I can have hope!」

731:t_105:0.en:
$$竜馬$$
「I don't give a damn about your problems! If you're coming after us, we'll fight back!」

731:t_105:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I don't dislike that kind of simple thinking.」

731:t_105:2.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Your liking me doesn't make me happy at all! I'll end this here, $$アサキム$$!」

731:t_105:3.en:
$$アサキム$$
「That is what I want too!」

731:t_106:0.en:
$$タケル$$
「What do you want after you defeat the $$御使い$$s!?」

731:t_106:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I have no need to tell you that.」

731:t_106:2.en:
$$タケル$$
「Why do you reject us!? Is there really no way we can join hands!?」

731:t_106:3.en:
$$アサキム$$
「This is the only way I can live... It is my destiny, and my sin!」

731:t_107:0.en:
$$シモン$$
「I'll end your eternity with my drill!」

731:t_107:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「It is eternal because it never ends. Can you not understand that?」

731:t_107:2.en:
$$シモン$$
「I've had enough of your bullshit logic! I'll pierce even eternity!」

731:t_107:3.en:
$$シモン$$
「Let's settle this, $$アサキム$$! We'll surpass even your immortality!!」

731:t_108:0.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Everyone close to you dies, one after another, while you alone live on through time... Surely you can understand me a little?」

731:t_108:1.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「That's why we'll fight to free you from eternity!」

731:t_108:2.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Then I will look forward to it. Though I have no intention of going easy on you.」

731:t_108:3.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「We don't need you to! You're our enemy too, after all!」

731:t_109:0.en:
$$ラルク$$
「We're trying to meet you halfway, even swallowing everything you've done to us...!」

731:t_109:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「We need overwhelming power to defeat them. Simply combining your strength with mine will not get us there.」

731:t_109:2.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Don't give up before we've even tried!」

731:t_109:3.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Then I'll make you acknowledge our strength! Even if I have to snap those black wings you're so proud of!」
